title: ziziphora eglandulosa
intro: Ziziphora eglandulosa, commonly known as Persian or Turkish mint, is a perennial herb belonging to the mint family (Lamiaceae). This plant is valued for its numerous health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help alleviate digestive issues, reduce fever, and soothe respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of Ziziphora eglandulosa include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as calming and sedative effects, as well as its ability to relieve stress and anxiety. The therapeutic actions of Ziziphora eglandulosa also include its potential to lower blood pressure and improve cardiovascular health.
